subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/implement#ticket-title-echo
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-13: Our implement playbook's step 1 reads the bead and claims it by exact ID (`.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/implement.md:119-120`), so a reference cannot resolve to the wrong item; saying the title first adds a turn without catching anything the exact ID leaves open.

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/implement#material-ambiguity-ask
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-13: AGENTS.md asks whenever an ambiguity materially affects correctness, scope or authority; a work reference that could name two items always affects scope, so the upstream case is one instance of the rule.

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/implement#test-first-where-possible

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/misc/git-guardrails-claude-code#pre-run-git-command-guard
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-13: Already in force here: `.claude/hooks/block-dangerous-commands.sh` blocks each of these before a shell command runs, registered at `.claude/settings.json:3-12`, and the plugin's template carries the same registration to every repository it sets up. A hook is not a unit the registry compares, so no row can show it as held; a second hook would duplicate it.

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/misc/git-guardrails-claude-code#block-every-push
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-13: Ours blocks only forced pushes (`.claude/hooks/block-dangerous-commands.sh`:20-21) and lets an authorized push run, as `AGENTS.md:72` allows; blocking every push would stop pushes the owner asked for.

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/misc/git-guardrails-claude-code#refusal-without-recourse
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-13: Ours tells the agent to ask the user before proceeding (`.claude/hooks/block-dangerous-commands.sh`:33), because AGENTS.md allows these commands with explicit approval (`AGENTS.md:70-73`); a flat refusal would leave a sanctioned request with no path.

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/misc/git-guardrails-claude-code#guard-install-scope-choice
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-13: Our guard ships as project configuration with the harness, so a repository gets it by adopting the harness; a user-wide install would act in repositories that never chose it.

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/misc/git-guardrails-claude-code#guard-hook-install
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-13: Nothing to install: `.claude/hooks/block-dangerous-commands.sh` and its registration already ship with the harness (`.claude/settings.json:3-12`).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/misc/git-guardrails-claude-code#settings-merge-not-overwrite
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-13: Sound, but no unit of ours writes into a settings file by hand now, so there is no place it would change what an agent does.
revisit_when: A unit of ours comes to edit a harness settings file in a repository by hand.

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/misc/git-guardrails-claude-code#guard-pattern-customization
